lanes.title: Give the legacy workspace shell's mobile sheet an accessible name and make sidebar resize keyboard-operable
lanes.no_parent_mention: the parent identifiers OVD-332, OVD-385, OVD-319, OVD-527, OVD-419, OVD-199, OVD-359
lanes.description: ORIGINAL SYNTHESIS SPEC (superseded wherever the BINDING CORRECTIONS below differ): scope: In ClientWorkspaceShell.tsx, add an sr-only SheetHeader, SheetTitle and SheetDescription in the SheetContent (:728-738), mirroring ClientProject.tsx:1709-1712. Make the resize separator (:542-550) focusable, with aria-value attributes and Arrow, Home and End keys using the existing width setter. No visual change beyond the focus ring token. | acceptance: The named dialog resolves at 390 px with no Radix DialogTitle console error. The separator is Tab-reachable, and the arrow keys change the width within bounds and update aria-valuenow. Existing tests pass. | verification_plan: Failure-first by extending ClientWorkspaceShell.test.tsx. Then npx vitest run src/components/workspace/ClientWorkspaceShell.test.tsx, npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test, and a keyboard-only Playwright pass. | risks: The sheet title is new copy; use a neutral label such as 'Workspace navigation'.
lanes.guidance:
BINDING CORRECTIONS from the judged 1.0 plan (these override the original spec): UI-LEGACY-SHELL-A11Y (NEW child of OVD-332; base main; branch claude/workspace-shell-a11y). Only 1 of the 3 judges put it in this run, so it takes the next main-based slot. It also absorbs the role=status part of UI-SYSTEM-PAGES. Spec: synthesis.json units[UI-LEGACY-SHELL-A11Y], with these corrections: (1) in ClientWorkspaceShell.tsx SheetContent (:728-738), add an sr-only SheetHeader and SheetTitle reading 'Workspace navigation' with no visible copy, mirroring ClientProject.tsx:1709-1712; (2) make the role=separator at :542-550 focusable, with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow, and Arrow, Home and End keys wired to the existing width setter; (3) wrap AuthBootstrapScreen.tsx's message (the

at :14, default text 'Restoring your session.') in role=status aria-live=polite, keeping the copy unchanged; (4) start with failing vitest tests; (5) run a keyboard-only Playwright pass at 390 px that shows no Radix DialogTitle console error. Lane B (visual system) is undecided: do not change radius, typography, mono/uppercase treatment, palette tokens or layout beyond what these corrections require; use only existing DESIGN.md/Tailwind tokens. Customer-facing copy must not change unless the corrections say so.
